Field.Label: Register an application at portal.azure.com (App registrations → New): "Personal Microsoft accounts only", NO redirect URI. Then, under Authentication, set "Allow public client flows" = Yes. Copy the Application (client) ID and paste it below. Authorize with an ADULT Microsoft account — child accounts cannot sign in to Xbox Live here.
How often to check presence (15–600 seconds). Lower values catch shorter sessions but make more API calls.
How often to check Xbox Console devices (15–600 seconds). Only spends an API call when at least one Xbox Console device is configured.

Open the verification URL in a browser and enter the user code, signing in with the ADULT account that follows the gamertags you want to track. The link and code are also written to the Event Log. This dialog can be closed while authorization completes in the background.
